field.description: 必须属于当前 dataset 的 filters，不能把分组别名用于筛选。各数据集允许值：{"approved_requests_without_rfq": [], "weekly_order_risks": [], "inventory_by_batch": ["product_id"], "accepted_orders_finance_gaps": [], "supplier_quote_delivery_profile": ["product_id", "supplier_id"], "inventory_movement_trace": ["batch_id", "product_id"], "purchase_requests": ["currency_code", "priority", "status"], "purchase_orders": ["currency_code", "region", "status", "supplier_name"], "deliveries": ["status", "supplier_name"], "inventory": ["product_name", "status", "warehouse_name"], "quality_acceptances": ["certificate_complete", "result"], "exceptions": ["severity", "status", "type"], "finance_reconciliations": ["currency_code", "status", "supplier_name"], "supplier_quotes": ["currency_code", "status", "supplier_name"], "inventory_transactions": ["product_name", "type", "warehouse_name"], "finance_invoices": ["currency_code", "status", "supplier_name"], "finance_payments": ["currency_code", "status", "supplier_name"], "suppliers": ["cooperation_level", "region", "status"]}
field.title: 筛选槽位

operator.description: eq=等于，contains=包含文本，gte=大于等于，lte=小于等于，in=属于集合。in 的 value 必须是数组；其余操作使用单个值。
operator.title: 筛选操作符

value.description: 用户明确给出或前置查询明确返回的值，不得猜测ID。状态使用业务编码：finance_invoices 已核验=VERIFIED；finance_payments 已付款=PAID。
value.title: 筛选值

dataset.description: 根据问题选择唯一数据集，不能选择无关数据集来凑合法输出。数据集含义：{"approved_requests_without_rfq": "已审批未建立询价单的采购申请", "weekly_order_risks": "本周订单履约风险", "inventory_by_batch": "产品批次可用库存", "accepted_orders_finance_gaps": "已验收订单财务进度", "supplier_quote_delivery_profile": "供应商报价、交期与异常表现", "inventory_movement_trace": "库存变动与冻结原因追溯", "purchase_requests": "采购申请", "purchase_orders": "采购订单", "deliveries": "入库单", "inventory": "库存", "quality_acceptances": "质量验收", "exceptions": "运营异常", "finance_reconciliations": "财务对账", "supplier_quotes": "供应商报价", "inventory_transactions": "库存流水", "finance_invoices": "财务发票", "finance_payments": "财务付款", "suppliers": "供应商"}
dataset.title: 查询数据集

metric.description: count=记录数量，amount=金额合计，sum_quantity=库存数量合计，records=固定业务明细。发票金额为含税金额；报价单价不得跨产品或单位求和；金额按币种分别统计。各数据集允许值：{"approved_requests_without_rfq": ["records"], "weekly_order_risks": ["records"], "inventory_by_batch": ["records"], "accepted_orders_finance_gaps": ["records"], "supplier_quote_delivery_profile": ["records"], "inventory_movement_trace": ["records"], "purchase_requests": ["amount", "count"], "purchase_orders": ["amount", "count"], "deliveries": ["count"], "inventory": ["count", "sum_quantity"], "quality_acceptances": ["count"], "exceptions": ["count"], "finance_reconciliations": ["amount", "count"], "supplier_quotes": ["count"], "inventory_transactions": ["count"], "finance_invoices": ["amount", "count"], "finance_payments": ["amount", "count"], "suppliers": ["count"]}
metric.title: 统计指标

time_field.description: 日期筛选依据的业务时间字段。采购订单本月统计使用 order_date；未限定日期可为 null；无时间字段的数据集必须为 null。各数据集允许值：{"approved_requests_without_rfq": [], "weekly_order_risks": [], "inventory_by_batch": [], "accepted_orders_finance_gaps": [], "supplier_quote_delivery_profile": [], "inventory_movement_trace": [], "purchase_requests": ["approved_at", "created_at", "expected_date", "submitted_at"], "purchase_orders": ["created_at", "expected_arrival_date", "order_date"], "deliveries": ["actual_arrival_date", "created_at", "expected_arrival_date"], "inventory": ["created_at", "expiry_date"], "quality_acceptances": ["created_at", "inspection_time"], "exceptions": ["created_at", "due_at"], "finance_reconciliations": ["created_at"], "supplier_quotes": ["created_at", "quote_date"], "inventory_transactions": ["created_at"], "finance_invoices": ["created_at", "invoice_date", "verified_at"], "finance_payments": ["approved_at", "created_at", "paid_at"], "suppliers": ["created_at"]}
time_field.title: 时间口径

date_from.description: 包含当天的 ISO 日期 YYYY-MM-DD；不限起始时间为 null。相对时间以输入 today 换算；本月从当月第一天开始。不得晚于 date_to。
date_from.title: 起始日期

date_to.description: 包含当天的 ISO 日期 YYYY-MM-DD；不限结束时间为 null。相对时间以输入 today 换算；本月截至 today，不能擅自扩展到未来月底。
date_to.title: 结束日期

group_by.description: 只能是一个维度字符串或 null，不能是数组。按供应商分组使用 supplier，不能使用筛选字段 supplier_name；金额会再按币种分组。各数据集允许值：{"approved_requests_without_rfq": [], "weekly_order_risks": [], "inventory_by_batch": [], "accepted_orders_finance_gaps": [], "supplier_quote_delivery_profile": [], "inventory_movement_trace": [], "purchase_requests": ["currency", "priority", "status"], "purchase_orders": ["currency", "region", "status", "supplier"], "deliveries": ["status", "supplier"], "inventory": ["expiry_date", "product", "status", "warehouse"], "quality_acceptances": ["certificate_complete", "result"], "exceptions": ["severity", "status", "type"], "finance_reconciliations": ["currency", "status", "supplier"], "supplier_quotes": ["currency", "status", "supplier"], "inventory_transactions": ["product", "type", "warehouse"], "finance_invoices": ["currency", "status", "supplier"], "finance_payments": ["currency", "status", "supplier"], "suppliers": ["cooperation_level", "region", "status"]}
group_by.title: 分组维度

filters.description: 按用户明确条件逐项填写；没有条件使用 []，不得猜测。已付款金额须筛选 status=PAID，已核验发票金额须筛选 status=VERIFIED。
filters.title: 筛选条件

order.description: asc=升序，desc=降序；金额最高、数量最多等排名使用 desc。
order.title: 排序方向

limit.description: 用户明确最多显示 N 家或 N 条时取 N；未指定取20。仅限制明细展示，不能将展示条数当作全范围统计数量。允许1至100。
limit.title: 最多展示条数
